## AICTE-VAANI Sponsored 3-Day Workshop on Mastering Prompt Engineering for Generative AI

09 Sep 2026 - 11 Sep 2026 |Organized by:Department of Emerging Technologies
The objective of the 3 Day Workshop on “Mastering Prompt Engineering for Generative AI” under the emerging field of Artificial Intelligence and Data Science is to provide participants with a comprehensive understanding of prompt engineering techniques and their critical role in effectively utilizing Generative AI technologies. The workshop aims to equip students, faculty members, researchers, and industry professionals with practical knowledge of designing, optimizing, and evaluating prompts for Large Language Models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and other AI-powered platforms.The program focuses on enhancing participants’ abilities to generate accurate, creative, and context-aware outputs for applications including content generation, coding assistance, data analysis, research support, automation, and decision-making. Through expert sessions, hands-on exercises, real-world case studies, and interactive demonstrations, participants will gain practical exposure to advanced prompting strategies, AI workflows, and responsible AI usage.The workshop also emphasizes ethical considerations, AI limitations, data privacy, bias mitigation, and best practices for human-AI collaboration in research and industry environments. The objective of the 3 Day Workshop on “Mastering Prompt Engineering for Generative AI” under the emerging field of Artificial Intelligence and Data Science is to provide participants with a comprehensive understanding of prompt engineering techniques and their critical role in effectively utilizing Generative AI technologies. The workshop aims to equip students, faculty members, researchers, and industry professionals with practical knowledge of designing, optimizing, and evaluating prompts for Large Language Models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and other AI-powered platforms.
The program focuses on enhancing participants’ abilities to generate accurate, creative, and context-aware outputs for applications including content generation, coding assistance, data analysis, research support, automation, and decision-making. Through expert sessions, hands-on exercises, real-world case studies, and interactive demonstrations, participants will gain practical exposure to advanced prompting strategies, AI workflows, and responsible AI usage.
The workshop also emphasizes ethical considerations, AI limitations, data privacy, bias mitigation, and best practices for human-AI collaboration in research and industry environments. By the end of the workshop, participants will be able to effectively leverage Generative AI tools to improve productivity, innovation, problem-solving capabilities, and digital transformation across diverse academic and industrial domains.

## Venue:

- MGIT.

## Event Guidelines:

REGISTRATION AND FEE PARTICULARS
- Last Date for Registration: 07.09.2026
- No Registration Fee
- No TA/DA will be provided to the participants
- Selection as per AICTE-VAANI guidelines & first cum- first-serve basis
- Participants are limited to 50
CERTIFICATE CRITERIA
- Minimum Attendance needed: 80%
- A test will be conducted at the end of the program
- Exam Score: Minimum 60% marks in the test
AICTE-VAANI Programme Schedule

## Target Audience:

- Faculty Members of AICTE Approved Institutions
- Research Scholars
- Persons working in R&D Organizations
- Industry Persons & PG Students

## Learning Outcomes / Course Outcomes:

After completing the workshop, participants will be able to:
- Understand the fundamentals ofPrompt Engineering, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs).
- Design clear, effective, and context-specific prompts for different AI applications.
- Applyprompt optimization techniquesto improve the accuracy and relevance of AI-generated outputs.
- Gain hands-on experience with popularGenerative AI tools and LLM-based platforms.
- DevelopAI-assisted solutionsfor academic, research, and industry-related tasks.
- Use Generative AI forcontent creation, data analysis, problem-solving, and research support.
- Evaluate AI-generated outputs foraccuracy, relevance, bias, and reliability.
- Apply Generative AI in aresponsible, ethical, and secure manner.

## Resource Persons:

- All from NITS/IITs and Industry Persons

## Coordinator:

- Dr. Rasmita Kumari Mohanty, Assistant Professor Dept. of Emerging Technologies, MGIT

## Co-Coordinator:

- Dr. M Rama Bai, Professor & Head Dept. of Emerging Technologies, MGIT
